body:
The twenty-ninth of September opens with a ban. It has a blackened façade, a midnight list and no new clause.

I. The list that takes at midnight

One minute after midnight Eastern time Washington closes a border. Canadian beer, wine, whisky, rum, whey, molasses and motorcycles may no longer enter. 1

The bans sit under Section 338. The entry date governs. 3

On 2025 figures the ban covers just under a billion dollars. Most of it is drink. 2

II. The house that holds knowledge

On Monday a drone hits the presidium of the Academy of Sciences in Kyiv. People climb fire ladders. Volodymyr Horbulin is wounded. 4 5

Dnipro, Kharkiv, a brief Polish alert. Metro AG placed under administration. 6 7 8

III. The tap that stays shut

No new clause. Mediators without a date. 17

IV. At the edge of the page

Israel kills Izz al-Din al-Beik in Gaza. Starship reaches orbit. 9 10

The chronicler's close

Open remain Hormuz without a treaty, the eastern field and the customs list.

The World Book does not close. It leaves a finger in the pages and waits for 30 September.
